name: Floot
description: Builds, edits, and publishes full-stack web apps with Postgres, auth, storage, and email from Claude, ChatGPT, Codex, or any MCP client via Floot's remote MCP server.

skills.name: Project Code Editing
skills.description: Creates Floot projects and reads, writes, patches, and searches their React and TypeScript files with create_project, edit_file, and apply_patch.

skills.name: Resource Provisioning
skills.description: Adds a managed database, authentication, or login provider to a project with provision_resource, seeding the code without pasting any keys.

skills.name: Database SQL
skills.description: Reads the project's Postgres data with query_database, runs writes and migrations with execute_sql, and regenerates typed schema helpers.

skills.name: Publish And Debug
skills.description: Publishes or unpublishes the app with publish_app, reads runtime logs with get_logs, and captures the live preview with screenshot_preview.
